name: Azarel
overview: Azarel is a male member of the tribe of Levi, identified specifically as the son of Ahzai. His mention in Nehemiah 11:13 situates him within the post-exilic community of Israel, reflecting his Levitical heritage. There are no additional notes recorded about him beyond his lineage.
namesAndTitles: The name Azarel means 'G-d [El] has helped,' revealing a theologically rich meaning that emphasizes divine assistance. This proper name, recorded in Nehemiah 11:13, was not given directly by God but carries a significant reminder of God's help to His people.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Azarel as the son of Ahzai. Additionally, it is inferred that Amashsai is his father, establishing a familial line within the Levites. Beyond these relationships, no further family details are provided.
scriptureSignificance: Azarel's significance lies in his identity as a Levite during the time of Nehemiah, highlighting the restoration of the priestly tribe after the exile. His lineage connects him to the religious leadership essential for Israel's worship and community life. Though not extensively detailed, his mention underscores the faithfulness of God's people in maintaining their priestly heritage.
